author: reviewer
comment: Confirmed by reading src/lib/weekly.ts myself (E-022, same sha256 as E-010). weekDayKeys uses (getDay() + 6) % 7 and local Date fields to build the Monday-to-Sunday local week. sleepAverage keeps only keys present in the sleep log. calorieAverage keeps only days where data.days[key] has at least one entry.
